Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 29, 2026

This Privacy Policy explains how 2021076 Ontario Corporation ("we", "us", or "our"), the operator of miloandfiadh.com in Ontario, Canada, handles information in connection with this website. For privacy questions or requests, email hi@miloandfiadh.com.

Information involved in visiting this site

This is a static website. It does not offer visitor accounts, comments, a shopping cart, or a contact form. If you email us, we receive the information you choose to include, such as your email address and message. Please do not send payment information or sensitive information about a child.

The site is hosted on GitHub Pages. GitHub and its delivery providers process technical information, such as IP addresses and request information, to deliver and protect the site. Their handling of that information is described in GitHub's Privacy Statement.

Optional analytics and your choice

Google Analytics is off unless you choose to allow optional analytics. Before that choice, this site does not load Google's analytics tag or send analytics requests to Google. Allowing analytics helps us understand visits, device and browser information, and how the site is used. Google may use first-party analytics cookies and process technical information, including IP information, in providing that service.

You can allow or turn off optional analytics below. Your choice is stored in this browser for up to 180 days, after which analytics returns to off unless you choose again. Your choice applies to this browser, not every device you use. If browser storage is unavailable, a choice applies only to the current page. Turning analytics off stops future collection on this site and removes the analytics cookies this site manages; it does not erase information already received by Google.

Optional analytics is off.

We do not enable advertising personalization through this site's analytics configuration. Website addresses sent by our analytics setup omit query strings and fragments; standard campaign labels may be included separately. Google describes its processing in its Privacy Policy and information about partner sites.

Amazon store preferences and external links

Amazon links can use your browser language and time zone to suggest an Amazon store. This happens in your browser without an IP-location service or a request for GPS access. If you choose a store manually, that preference is saved in local browser storage until you reset it or clear your browser data.

Purchases take place on Amazon, not on this website. We do not receive your card details or Amazon account password through this site. Amazon and linked social platforms apply their own privacy policies when you visit them. Some Amazon links are affiliate links and include our affiliate tracking details. As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.

How we use and share information

We use information you send us to respond to your message, handle your request, and maintain related business records. Optional analytics is used to understand and improve the website. Service providers may process information to provide hosting, email, or analytics services. Information may also be disclosed when required by law or reasonably necessary to protect legal rights and security.

Retention, security, and international processing

We keep correspondence and related records for as long as reasonably needed for the request, legitimate business purposes, and applicable legal obligations. Hosting, email, and analytics providers may process information outside your province or country, including in the United States, under their own applicable arrangements and retention settings. No method of internet transmission or storage is completely secure.

Children and family privacy

The books are for young children, but this website's purchasing, contact, and privacy choices are intended for parents and other grown-ups. We do not ask children to submit personal information. If you believe a child has sent us personal information, contact us so we can review and address it.

Your questions and requests

You can ask about the personal information we hold about you, request access or correction, or raise a privacy concern by emailing hi@miloandfiadh.com. Depending on the law that applies, you may also have rights to request deletion or withdraw consent. We may need to verify your identity before responding, and legal exceptions or recordkeeping requirements may apply. You can also contact the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada about an unresolved concern.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy when the website or our practices change. The date above shows the latest revision.
